patches_added.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_added.description: Lets you hide the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over a pin you open, each with its own switch, so they stop covering the picture. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Pinterest icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Echo Pro, including the 15- and 31-band equalizers, compressor, limiter and Safe Hearing protect mode.

patches_added.name: GmsCore support
patches_added.description: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks downloading every surah, lyrics and tafsir, Android Auto, background playback controls, and insights.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Stops crash and error reports from reaching Sentry.

patches_modified.name: Disable usage tracking
patches_modified.description: Stops app usage events from being uploaded. Local usage tracking remains enabled.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the energy schedule, habit tools, smart alarm and progress insights. Requires a RISE account.

patches_modified.name: Disable tracking
patches_modified.description: Disables analytics and crash reporting.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all premium features.

patches_modified.name: Unlock pro
patches_modified.description: Unlocks task lists, callouts, app lock, and the notebook, tag, colour and reminder limits. Requires a signed-in account. The server still enforces storage, attachment size, monographs and SMS 2FA.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and Also from Meta in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, so you can open these settings from inside Messenger. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Stop MQTT logging
patches_modified.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger's MQTT client sends. Messenger 582 sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messages, calls and active status share that connection and keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hushfacebook settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Its App name option shows a name you pick under the icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Hushfacebook settings to Facebook, where you turn features on or off, pause Hushfacebook and back up your choices. To open them, long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed or Facebook's app icon. Other patches need it, so keep it selected.

patches_modified.name: Keep the progress bar
patches_modified.description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap, and another switch lets a tap anywhere on the bar jump there. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Keeps every reel's progress bar full size and moving smoothly, with the time above it, so you can drag it without tapping first. Also keeps a full-screen video's controls on screen until you tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. patches_modified.previous_description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. A second switch lets it slide away as you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_added.description: Adds MAIN and DEFAULT intent-filters to MusicActivity so external controllers like Google Maps can open the app.

patches_added.name: Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction
patches_added.description: Forces CapCut GeoBlock config lists (cert, dock, entrance, page, scheme) to empty so region-blocked surfaces stay enabled. Server-refused content may still fail to load.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the Save button and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons while you aren't touching the screen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Find the reel you came from
patches_modified.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and outlines it for a moment. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Search, Create and Profile, another puts Messages on the bar when Instagram left it off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search button and a Ghost mode button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, one centers the name at the top of profiles, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches_modified.name: Install next to Instagram
patches_modified.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
patches_modified.previous_description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Default video quality
patches_added.description: Starts every video at one resolution instead of the app's per-video choice; a resolution the video lacks falls back to its highest available (8K included when the stream spoof provides it). Changeable in the headset's Patch settings; Auto keeps the app's own behaviour.

patches_removed.name: Spoof osName (Android Automotive)
patches_removed.description: Reports the app as an Android Automotive device, the way the phone patch set blocks video ads.

patches_modified.name: Disable QUIC protocol
patches_modified.description: Adds an option (off by default) to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol; selecting the patch alone changes nothing until the option is enabled.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to disable QUIC (Quick UDP Internet Connections) network protocol.

patches_modified.name: Extension
patches_modified.description: Injects the extension the other patches run through: its streaming spoof is what removes the pre-roll (ad-free playback) and provides the 8K format support. Turning this patch off restores ads.
patches_modified.previous_description: Injects the YouTube VR patch extension used by streaming patches.

patches_modified.name: Hide stitched ads (SSAI)
patches_modified.description: Removes the client side ad configuration and cue points for server-stitched (SSAI) streams. It does not remove the ad itself; keeping ads out is the Extension patch's streaming spoof. Off by default.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the client side ad configuration and cue points for server-stitched (SSAI) streams. Does not remove the ad itself; off by default.

patches_modified.name: SponsorBlock
patches_modified.description: Automatically skips SponsorBlock segments (sponsors, self-promos, intros, ...). On by default (sponsors: skip once); configure per-category behaviour below or in the headset's Patch settings screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Automatically skips SponsorBlock segments (sponsors, self-promos, intros, ...). Off by default; configure per-category behaviour below.
